title: headwater-release-list/1
description: What `headwater release list --json` prints: each folder of the cache, `releases/` in HEADWATER_HOME, with the release it holds or why it cannot be read. Example: `headwater release list --json`.

release.description: `name@hash`, with the first 12 characters of the hash, as a database pins it.

kind.description: source: imported from a source. indicators: solved indicator vectors for one method.

bytes.description: The size of the folder's files.

error.description: Why the folder does not read as a release.

releases.description: One entry per folder of the cache, sorted by name. A folder that reads as a release has `release`, `hash` and `kind`. One that does not has `error`.
